writing.topic: 改变了我的一件事(现在完成时)
writing.prompt: Write about something (a hobby, a book, or an activity) that has changed you. Use the present perfect tense (have/has + past participle).
writing.promptCn: 写一段,讲一件改变了你的事物(一个爱好、一本书或一项活动)。用现在完成时(have/has+过去分词)。
writing.opener: Over the past few years, one thing has really changed me.

l1: I have learnt many things from it.
l2: A few years ago, {activity} came into my life, and it has changed me a lot.
Since then, I have learnt so many things from it.
It has slowly made me {change}.
Now I feel {feel}, and I cannot imagine my life without it.
l3: A few years ago, {activity} quietly came into my life, and since then it has changed me in many ways.
I have learnt more from it than from anything else, and it has opened a whole new world for me.
Step by step, it has made me {change}, and it has become a real part of who I am.
I have never felt so {feel}. This small thing has truly changed my life for the better.

writing.topic: 我坚持很久的爱好或友情(现在完成时 since/for)
writing.prompt: Write about a hobby or a friend you have had for a long time. Use the present perfect with since and for.
writing.promptCn: 写一段,讲一个你拥有了很久的爱好或朋友。用现在完成时 + since/for。
writing.opener: There is something I have loved for a very long time.

cards.hint: 如 playing the guitar / my old friend

l1: I have loved {hobby} for many years.
I have never given it up.
l2: I have loved {hobby} since {start}, and I still enjoy it today.
I have kept it up for many years now.
It has never grown boring to me.
Every time I do it, I feel {feel} and free.
l3: I have loved {hobby} since {start}, and I have never grown tired of it, even for a single day.
For all these years, it has stayed by my side like an old friend.
I have spent countless happy hours on it, and it has given me more joy than words can say.
Some things come and go, but this one has stayed with me for a long, long time, and I feel so {feel}.

writing.topic: 我喜欢做的事和我想做的事(不定式/动名词作宾语)
writing.prompt: Write about a hobby you enjoy doing and something you want to learn or do. Use infinitives (to do) and gerunds (doing).
writing.promptCn: 写一段,讲一个你喜欢做的爱好,以及你想学或想做的一件事。用不定式(to do)和动名词(doing)。
writing.opener: In my free time, I enjoy doing something I really love.

l1: I have decided to practise it every day.
I never want to give up.
l2: In my free time, I enjoy {hobby} more than anything.
Last year, I decided to work harder, and now I keep practising every day.
I also hope to learn {goal} one day.
I have promised myself to keep trying and never to give up.
l3: Of all the things I do, I enjoy {hobby} the most, and I can spend hours on it without feeling tired.
A while ago, I decided to work much harder, so now I keep practising it almost every single day.
I also really hope to learn {goal}, because I love trying new and difficult things.
I have promised myself to keep going and never to give up, no matter how hard it becomes.

writing.topic: 帮助我成长的人(不定式作宾补)
writing.prompt: Write about someone who helps you (a coach, a friend, an elder) and what they ask or teach you to do. Use verb + object + to do.
writing.promptCn: 写一段,讲一个帮助你的人(教练、朋友或长辈),以及他/她要求或教你做的事。用'动词+宾语+不定式'。
writing.opener: There is someone who often helps me become a better person.

cards.hint: 如 my coach / my best friend

l1: This person tells me to work hard.
This person asks me to keep calm.
And this person makes me feel strong.
l2: {person} has helped me grow in many ways.
When I feel lazy, this person tells me to try my best.
This person also asks me to be honest and kind.
Little by little, this person is teaching me to become {quality}.
l3: For as long as I remember, {person} has helped me grow into a better person.
Whenever I want to give up, this person gently tells me to keep going and never to fear a mistake.
This person often asks me to be honest, to work hard, and to care about other people.
Day by day, {person} is teaching me to become {quality}, and I really want to make this person proud of me.

writing.topic: 我的好习惯和它的理由(不定式表目的)
writing.prompt: Write about a good habit you have and explain why you do it. Use the infinitive of purpose (to do) to give reasons.
writing.promptCn: 写一段,讲一个你的好习惯,并说明你为什么这样做。用不定式表目的(to do)说明原因。
writing.opener: I have a small habit, and I keep it for a good reason.

cards.hint: 如 get up early / read every night

l1: I do this to stay healthy.
I also do it to save time.
It helps me to feel good.
l2: Every morning I {habit}, and I never miss it.
I do this mainly to stay healthy and to keep my mind clear.
I also do it in order to save time for the things I love.
In the end, this small habit helps me to feel happy and ready.
l3: Every single morning, without fail, I {habit}, because I have learnt its real value.
I do this first of all to stay healthy and strong, and to keep my mind fresh and clear for school.
I also keep this habit in order to save time, and to make room for the people I love.
It is only a small thing, but I do it every day to build a better life, one step at a time.

writing.topic: 我难忘的一刻(过去进行时)
writing.prompt: Write about a moment you will never forget — what you were doing when something happened. Use the past continuous tense (was/were doing).
writing.promptCn: 写一段,讲一个你难忘的时刻——当某事发生时你正在做什么。用过去进行时(was/were doing)。
writing.opener: I will never forget what happened that day.

cards.hint: 如 it began to rain hard

l1: Near me, some children were laughing and playing.
l2: It was a quiet afternoon, and I was {activity} without a care.
Not far away, some children were laughing and running.
All at once, {event}, and everyone was looking around in shock.
My heart was beating fast, and I could not move at all.
l3: It was an ordinary afternoon, and I was {activity}, thinking about nothing at all.
Around me, some children were laughing, running, and enjoying the warm afternoon sun without a care in the world.
Then, all of a sudden, {event}. Everyone stopped, and people were shouting and running towards the noise.
My heart was beating so fast that I could hardly breathe. I stood there without moving, and I have never forgotten that moment from that day to this.

writing.topic: 一样东西如何被制造和使用(被动·现在/将来)
writing.prompt: Write about how a food or a product is made and used. Use the passive voice (is/are + past participle, will be + past participle).
writing.promptCn: 写一段,讲一种食物或物品如何被制造和使用。用被动语态(is/are+过去分词、will be+过去分词)。
writing.opener: Have you ever thought about how the things around us are made?

cards.hint: 如 to eat / to write on

l1: It is sold in many shops.
More will be made in the future.
l2: {product} is made from {material} in a factory.
First it is cleaned, and then it is packed with care.
It is sold in shops and is used {use} by many people.
In the future, even more will be made by machines.
l3: Every day, {product} is made from {material} in large factories.
First the material is cleaned, and then it is turned into the final product with care.
When it is ready, it is packed, sent to markets, and sold in shops all over the town.
It is used {use} by many people, and in the years to come, even more of it will be made and will be delivered by machines.

writing.topic: 一处老建筑/老物件的故事(被动·过去)
writing.prompt: Write about an old building or object in your town and what happened to it. Use the past passive (was/were + past participle).
writing.promptCn: 写一段,讲你家乡一处老建筑或老物件及其经历。用一般过去时被动(was/were+过去分词)。
writing.opener: Not far from my home, there is an old place, and everyone in the town loves it.

cards.hint: 如 an old bridge / a stone house

l2: {thing} was built long ago by the people of my town.
It was made of {material}, and it was used by everyone.
For many years it was kept safe and was cared for.
But then things changed, and at last it {fate}.
l3: Long ago, {thing} was built by the people of my hometown, and it soon became a part of their lives.
It was made of {material}, and for many years it was used and was loved by everyone in the town.
Later, sad news was heard: the old place was almost lost, and its story was nearly forgotten.
But the people were not ready to give it up. Letters were written, a meeting was held, and in the end it {fate}.

units.title: Unit 3 What makes a great team?

writing.topic: 一个社团/运动及其规则(情态动词)
writing.prompt: Write about a club, team or sport you like and its rules. Use modal verbs (can, must, have to, should).
writing.promptCn: 写一段,讲一个你喜欢的社团、团队或运动及其规则。用情态动词(can, must, have to, should)。
writing.opener: Every good team needs a few simple rules for everyone to keep.

cards.hint: 如 our football team / the art club

l1: You have to follow the rules.
l2: If you join {club}, you must {rule} and you have to come on time.
There you can learn to {skill}, and you can make many good friends.
Members must never give up, and they should always try their best.
Together we can do much more than one person could.
l3: If you want to join {club}, there are a few rules you must keep: you must {rule}, and you have to be there on time.
In return, you can learn to {skill}, and you can slowly build real confidence and strength.
Every member should respect the others, and no one should ever leave a teammate behind.
It is not always easy, but together we can go much further than one person could ever go alone.

writing.topic: 一件神秘的事·做推测(情态动词·推测)
writing.prompt: Write about a mysterious thing and make guesses about it. Use modal verbs of guessing (must be, may be, might be, can't be).
writing.promptCn: 写一段,讲一件神秘的事并作出推测。用表推测的情态动词(must be, may be, might be, can't be)。
writing.opener: One evening, something strange happened, and at first no one could explain it.

cards.hint: 如 a light in an empty house

l2: One night I noticed {mystery}, and I felt {feeling}.
'It must be something unusual,' I thought.
'It may be {guess}, or it might be only the wind.'
But such a thing can't be anything truly dangerous.
l3: Late one evening, I noticed {mystery}, and at once I felt {feeling}.
'Someone must be there,' I said to myself, 'because such a thing can't happen on its own.'
'It may be {guess},' I thought, 'or it might be something far more ordinary.'
In the end, the truth can't be as frightening as it seems. Most mysteries, I have found, must be far simpler and kinder than we ever feared.

writing.topic: 我相信/学到的一个道理(宾语从句·that)
writing.prompt: Write about a fact or lesson you have learnt and believe. Use object clauses with that (I think that..., I have learnt that...).
writing.promptCn: 写一段,讲一个你学到并相信的道理或事实。用 that 引导的宾语从句(I think that…, I have learnt that…)。
writing.opener: Over the years, I have learnt an important lesson, and I will never forget it.

l1: I believe that this is true.
l2: I strongly think that {lesson}, and my own life has shown me why.
Long ago I found that {reason}, and I have never forgotten it.
I believe that we can all do better if we keep trying.
Now I am sure that this simple idea is really true.
l3: After many years, I have learnt that {lesson}, and I am now sure that it is one of the most important ideas in my life.
At first I did not understand it, but slowly I found that {reason}, and everything began to make sense.
I believe that hard days make us stronger, and I know that no real success ever comes easily.
Whenever I feel like giving up, I remember that small steps still move us forward, and that patience always brings its reward.

writing.topic: 我好奇想知道的事(宾语从句·if/whether/wh)
writing.prompt: Write about things you are curious about. Use object clauses with if/whether and question words (I wonder why..., I want to know whether...).
writing.promptCn: 写一段,讲你好奇想弄明白的事。用 if/whether 和疑问词引导的宾语从句(I wonder why…, I want to know whether…)。
writing.opener: There are so many things in the world, and I am curious about them.

l1: I often wonder why {topic} is so amazing.
I am not sure whether anyone can answer this.
Nobody really knows when it began.
l2: Ever since I was young, I have wondered why {topic} is the way it is.
I really want to know how {question}, and I often ask whether others feel the same.
Sometimes I am not sure whether such questions have any answer at all.
But I understand why we keep asking: curious minds never stop.
l3: For as long as I can remember, I have wondered why {topic} is so full of wonder, and the question stays with me every day.
I truly want to know how {question}, and I often ask myself whether people long ago wondered about the very same things.
I am not always sure whether every question has an answer, or when the answers might finally appear.
Still, I understand why we never stop asking. To wonder why the world works this way is, I believe, one of the finest parts of being human.
